Your Laptop Isn’t Slow. Your Development Stack Got Heavier.
Why modern full-stack development now demands workstation-class hardware
Friend link for non Medium members
Before You Read Any Further…
Ask yourself honestly.

• Are you really a full-stack developer if your laptop struggles to run your full stack?

• How many times a day do you wait for Docker, builds, or your IDE instead of writing code?

• When was the last time you upgraded your development machine — not because it broke, but because your workload changed?

• Are you optimizing your code while ignoring the tool you spend eight hours a day using?

• Is your laptop helping you build software, or is it constantly asking you to wait?

• How much engineering time have you lost this week because your machine ran out of memory?

• If you’re investing hundreds of hours learning AI, cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, and mobile development, why are you running them on hardware from another era?

• Has your development stack evolved faster than your laptop?
If some of those questions made you pause, you’re probably not alone.
Because I started asking myself exactly the same questions.
